text:
About 84% of Indians said in 2019 that belief in God is necessary to be moral and have good values. That's my recollection of Pew's 2019 Global Attitudes Survey, and I haven't re-checked it against the source. The team note's "a little under six in ten" doesn't match what I remember, and I can't confirm it. As far as I recall, India was near the top of the surveyed countries on this question, not well below them.

CONFIDENCE: 78
